stories.title: NBA Summer Forecast: Which top rookies will reach stardom first?
stories.summary: NBA insiders predict which top rookies will make the biggest long-term impact in their careers and who can reach stardom.

stories.title: Bill Rasmussen, co-founder of ESPN, dies at 93
stories.summary: Bill Rasmussen, whose vision and ambition fueled the 1979 launch of ESPN as the world's first 24-hour television network, died Tuesday. He was 93.

stories.title: Sources: Seahawks still plan on signing CB Arnold
stories.summary: The Seattle Seahawks are still planning to sign cornerback Terrion Arnold, but it will take a while, as they are working through the timing, sources told NFL Network.

stories.title: Barça officially sign WC star Rodri from Man City
stories.summary: Spain's World Cup winning captain Rodri has completed his transfer from Manchester City to Barcelona.

stories.title: Padres minor league coordinator detained by ICE
stories.summary: Oswaldo Pirela, the minor league catching coordinator for the Padres, was detained by ICE at the El Paso International Airport early Sunday.
